title: The Party and the Failure of Revolution in the West
text:
# The Party and the Failure of Revolution in the West

Routledge eBooks. Published: 2023-07-10. Book chapter. 0 citations.

## Abstract

For the past sixty years socialist militants and theorists have attempted to explain why no revolution has occurred in the advanced capitalist countries. Marx had clearly indicated that the development of capitalism and the sharpening contradiction between capital and labour which accompanied it would create the most propitious conditions for a socialist revolution. The Leninist tradition offers one explanation of this situation; the working class lacked revolutionary leadership. The first group of explanations concentrates on the class structure of capitalist states, and in particular on their working classes and their socialist parties. The working class was obliged to adopt the ideology of the bourgeoisie. An important element in the transition from an ideology of subordinate class solidarity to a revolutionary world-view is the revolutionary intellectual.
